# NetEngineerLab

> Free bilingual network engineering calculators and planning tools for fiber optics, PON, IPv6, Ethernet, Wi-Fi, PoE, batteries, and optical transceivers.

Canonical site: https://netengineerlab.com/
Chinese homepage: https://netengineerlab.com/zh/
Tools directory: https://netengineerlab.com/tools/
Chinese tools directory: https://netengineerlab.com/tools/zh/
Sitemap: https://netengineerlab.com/sitemap.xml

## Tools

- 48V Battery Runtime: https://netengineerlab.com/tools/48v-battery-runtime/
- Bandwidth Calculator: https://netengineerlab.com/tools/bandwidth-calculator/
- Fiber Loss Calculator: https://netengineerlab.com/tools/fiber-loss/
- IPv6 NAT Planner: https://netengineerlab.com/tools/ipv6-nat-planner/
- MTU Calculator: https://netengineerlab.com/tools/mtu-calculator/
- ONU RX Power Calculator: https://netengineerlab.com/tools/onu-rx-power/
- Optical Power Budget: https://netengineerlab.com/tools/optical-power-budget/
- OTDR Event Calculator: https://netengineerlab.com/tools/otdr-event/
- PoE Power Budget Calculator: https://netengineerlab.com/tools/poe-power-budget-calculator/
- PON Distance Calculator: https://netengineerlab.com/tools/pon-distance/
- PON Splitter Loss Calculator: https://netengineerlab.com/tools/pon-splitter-loss/
- SFP/QSFP Compatibility Calculator: https://netengineerlab.com/tools/sfp-qsfp-compatibility-calculator/
- Subnet Calculator: https://netengineerlab.com/tools/subnet-calculator/
- Wi-Fi Coverage and Capacity Planner: https://netengineerlab.com/tools/wifi-coverage-capacity-planner/

## Language

Every tool has an English page and a Chinese page. Chinese tool pages use the corresponding `/zh/` route. Prefer the canonical and hreflang declarations in each page when selecting a URL.

## Usage notes

Calculations are engineering aids. Users should validate assumptions, vendor specifications, standards, and field conditions before deployment.
